_notes: Game-feel numbers from the prototype. Seconds, metres. Source file noted per block.

breakup.rule: Smoke-family puffs whose end size ≥ 1.4 m, 55% chance: when they reach full size they split into 2 children instead of fading.

motion.flame_family: S-curve lick upward (flame, hellflame, holy, plasma)
motion.smoke_family: roll and curl (hotsmoke, smoke, dust, mist, steam, frostfog, void, sand, scald, necro, arcane, voidglow, hex)

casting.hold: 0.03 + 0.07 × min(1, weight) — held breath; pin-point flare at the tip when it starts
casting.gather_rate: (60 + 160 × weight) particles/s into the staff tip, ×1.6 while held
casting.foot_dust: 6 + 8 × weight puffs kicked backward (not for flick)

slam.ground: crack decal, dust ring, shell, element eruption 1.1 m ahead

sweep.windup_fx: energy coils around waist against the swing
sweep.release: 0.16 s crescent of element around the body

plant.release: rune circle, vertical beam, crack where staff meets floor

flick.release: 16-spark fan off the wrist, small flare

thrust.windup_fx: energy streams past the body into the staff
thrust.release: flare + cone of displaced air along aim
